words: The manual way to send a push. Day to day, pushes go out by automation; you run this only when the automation is down or being checked.
A responsible-gaming or loss-chasing flag on the player. It beats every push: no push at all, route to welfare.
The target group for the push (tier, days since last deposit, or a campaign list). Never a blanket send.
The upload file types. TC takes .txt, Zyra takes .csv exported from the BO. The wrong type fails the upload.
The subject and content from the Template Tab or the campaign's signed-off set. Anything new or edited goes to the ATL first.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Should you send this push by hand?
items: The automation is down or being verified
The copy is approved (Template Tab or the campaign set)
RG / chase-flagged players are removed from the list
tour.done: All three: build the list and send by hand.
tour.notYet: Automation running: let it send. Copy not approved: ask the ATL first.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Six steps
items: Approved copy
Subject and content from the Template Tab or campaign set.
Build the list
Correct brand tab, target segment only. Remove RG / chase-flagged players.
Export
TC .txt, Zyra .csv. Check the format before you leave the file.
Open the push tool
TC: Interact Management, Mail, Push Notification, Send, Specific User, Firebase. Zyra: Notification, Push Notification, Add.
Upload and send
Upload the file, paste the approved copy in each language slot. TC: OK. Zyra: Create.
Log it
QA Record: brand, segment, push type, recipient count, time, plus a BO screenshot.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Five hard stops
items: Push a player with an RG / chase flag.
Send to everyone instead of the target segment.
Use copy that is not approved.
Over-promise an offer. Every offer states its validity.
Log a send that did not happen. An empty list is recorded and told to the ATL.

tour.label: TC vs Zyra
tour.title: The two platforms
items: TC path
Interact Management, Mail, Push Notification, Send Notification, Specific User, Firebase App Messaging.
TC file
.txt user file. Button: OK.
Zyra path
Notification, Push Notification, Add Push Notification. Target Type: User.
Zyra file
.csv exported from the BO. Button: Create.

tour.label: Empty list
tour.title: The list came out empty
tour.q: Is the recipient list empty after filtering?
tour.yes: Record it in the QA Record and tell the ATL. Never log a send that did not happen.
tour.no: Export in the right format and send.

pool.q: The push automation is running normally. Do you send the daily pushes by hand?
o: No; the manual procedure is only for when automation is down or being verified
pool.why: Pushes run on automation day to day. This SOP is the Fire Drill fallback.

pool.q: A player on the push list has an RG / chase flag. What do you do?
o: Remove them and route to welfare; no push
pool.why: The RG / chase flag beats every push. No push at all; route to welfare.

pool.q: You are uploading a TC push list. Which file type?
pool.why: TC takes .txt, Zyra takes .csv. The wrong format fails the upload.

pool.q: You want to try a new push headline. What first?
o: Get approval from the ATL first
pool.why: No ad-hoc copy without approval. New or edited copy goes to the ATL first.

pool.q: Can you send a risk push to all users of a brand to save time?
What goes in the QA Record after a push?
o: Brand, segment, push type, recipient count, time and a BO screenshot
pool.why: Log every send with those details and a BO screenshot. No screenshot, no proof of send.

pool.q: Your filtered push list is empty. What do you do?
o: Record it in the QA Record and tell the ATL
pool.why: Record an empty list and inform the ATL. Never fabricate a send.
